body.content:
This privacy policy explains how Unleashed Potential Psychotherapy ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses and protects information when you visit https://uptherapygroup.com (the "Site"). By using the Site, you agree to the practices described here.

## Information we collect

**Information you give us.** When you request a consultation, share a review or contact us, we collect the details you enter. These can include your name, email address, phone number, preferred appointment time and your message.

**Information collected automatically.** When you visit the Site, our hosting and analytics tools may collect basic technical details. These include your browser type, device, the pages you view, the site that referred you and the date and time of your visit.

**Cookies.** The Site may use cookies and similar tools to keep the Site working, to protect forms from spam and to understand how visitors use the Site. You can block or delete cookies in your browser settings.

## How we use information

We use the information we collect to:

- Respond to your requests and schedule consultations.
- Send you confirmations and messages about your request.
- Publish reviews you choose to share, with your name shortened.
- Protect the Site and its forms from spam and abuse.
- Understand how the Site is used, so we can improve it.

We do not sell your personal information.

## How we share information

We share information only with service providers that help us run the Site and the practice, such as hosting, email, calendar, form protection and analytics providers. These providers may use the information only to perform services for us. We may also share information if the law requires it, or to protect the safety of any person.

## How long we keep information

We keep the information you send us only as long as we need it for the purposes in this policy, or as long as the law requires.

## How we protect information

We use reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your information. However, no method of sending or storing data over the internet is completely secure, so we cannot guarantee absolute security.

## Your choices

You can ask us to see, correct or delete the personal information you have sent us. You can also ask us to stop sending you messages. To make a request, contact us at the address below.

## Children

The Site is not directed to children under 13, and we do not knowingly collect personal information from them through the Site.

## Links to other websites

The Site may link to other websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those websites, and we encourage you to read their privacy policies.

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. When we do, we change the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

## Contact us

If you have questions about this policy, write to us at Unleashed Potential Psychotherapy, 169 Commack Road #1015, Commack, NY 11725.
